items.title: Johnny Wiggs Interview, 1969-12-14
items.q: The interviewee (Johnny Wiggs) is the guest on a show hosted by Eddie Saber. The transcript shows Eddie Saber introducing the guest and managing the call-in segment, but Johnny Wiggs never mentions Eddie Saber, nor does he describe any personal or professional interaction with him.

ctx.x: that nana. It's Johnny's record. I don't know what to do. You can write to him in Columbia, South Carolina. It will be out, but when, I don't know, poor George Buck has got 150 trillion new masters, which he's just purchased, and I don't know when he's going to get to put them all out. So the best way to do is to try to get to dig it out of some record shop. Just continue. There's an awful fine record man. You tell me his name. He has his record shop on Royal right near Canal Joe. I can't remember the man's name.…

there's a very, very interesting story behind Snoozer Quinn's rendition, and that was Snoozer's Wanderings. And I want Mr. Johnny Wiggs to tell us just how that record was recorded. Well, I hope we have time to start at the beginning. I met Snoozer when Peck Kelly sent for me. Peck Kelly was considered one of the greatest piano players that ever lived.
